note: Committed fixtures are SYNTHETIC: hand-authored markup reproducing the structural shapes measured on a real saved Watch Later page, with invented video ids, titles and channel names. The real page is local-only and gitignored, because it is the collector's personal viewing history. See README.md in this directory for the measurements.

files.describes: 12 ytd-playlist-video-renderer rows covering: all three view-count shapes (#K / #M / bare), both duration shapes (M:SS and H:MM:SS), a /channel/UC byline, an href-less byline anchor (name, no url), an is-empty byline (neither), [Private video] and [Deleted video] placeholders, skipped and duplicated ordinals, the hidden always-empty #attributed-channel-name trap, a second id="text" element per row, and decoy watch?v= anchors plus a leftover ytInitialData blob outside every row.
files.regenerate: Hand-authored. Edit directly. Every new extraction bug found in real data should become another row here.

files.describes: The real saved Watch Later page the connector was measured against: 582 rows, 639 page-wide unique watch?v= ids, 100% coverage on id/title/duration/index/views, 99.48% on channel name, 96.74% on channel url, 0 placeholder rows, 0 playlistVideoRenderer nodes in ytInitialData.
files.regenerate: Open your own YouTube Watch Later playlist while logged in, scroll to the end, then save the page with Ctrl+S as 'Web Page, Complete' into fixtures/youtube/_local/. NEVER commit it — it is your viewing history. Absence is expected and is reported as skipped, not as a failure.
